I made a one-line fix in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/landscape/statichtml/LandscapeReportGenerator.java` (around line 634, in `addSubLandscapeSection`).

The NPE came from `Metadata metadata = subLandscapeConfig.getMetadata();`. `getSubLandscapeConfig` returns null when a sub-landscape's `config.json` is missing or unreadable, so the dereference aborted the parent report. It now reads:

```java
Metadata metadata = subLandscapeConfig != null ? subLandscapeConfig.getMetadata() : new Metadata();
```

A new `Metadata` has an empty `logoLink`, so the existing branch renders the default landscape logo and the row keeps its link to the sub-landscape's index page. Sub-landscapes with a readable config take the same path as before, so their logos are unchanged. The figures lookup already tolerated a missing `landscapeAnalysisResults.json`, so it needed no change.

`mvn -q -o -pl reports test -Dtest='LandscapeReportGenerator*'` compiled and ran without output, which I read as passing. I did not build a parent landscape with a broken sub-landscape to confirm the report completes end to end, so that is still unverified. Nothing is committed.
